invariants.rationale: properties is dereferenced by properties.put(name, castValue) in the method.
name is used as a parameter in castProperty and properties.put, both likely requiring non-null.
At least one of value or type may be needed for castProperty to perform a conversion.
Likely that an empty name is not meaningful as a property key.
If value is non-null, it is likely to be non-empty for a property to be meaningful.
